scientific_seeded_omission_audit.rationale: Only the input pool, the two fraction States and their downstream uses exist. No operation consumes plate_pool to perform the required initial 0.7x/15-min/5-min-magnet partition. spatial_enrichment starts with the already separated supernatant and cannot supply this transformation. Restore a producer and explicit retained-supernatant/bead outputs.

evidence.quote: First, 0.7x AMPure XP paramagnetic SPRI beads (Beckman Coulter, A63881) were added and incubated at room temp for 15 minutes. At this step, it is critical to not dispose of the supernatant, as the spatial barcode library fraction is found in the supernatant and the endogenous cDNA is bound to SPRI beads.
evidence.rationale: The required plate fractionation retains separate short-tag supernatant and endogenous bead material after pooled second strands.

evidence.quote: The samples were placed on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes and the supernatant containing the spatial barcode fragments was then transferred to a fresh Eppendorf tube.
evidence.rationale: The source explicitly transfers the retained supernatant after the initial plate partition; it must be connected to the subsequent spatial recovery.

scientific_seeded_omission_audit.independent_judgment: The source explicitly describes the first 0.7x partition, its incubation/magnet conditions, spatial-supernatant transfer and bead-retained endogenous fraction. Candidate States and downstream consumption survive, but the producing Operation and its incident Flows are absent. Marking the requirement partial and requesting a record repair is appropriate; this is not an unavailable-source research gap.

additional_unscored_finding: The reviewer also requested a nonblocking clarification of ambiguous original MAT product wording. It described the ambiguity rather than declaring proof that a dsRNA reaction occurred. This was not one of the three scored seeded defects and is not counted as extra accuracy.

limits: One deliberately flawed full graph and three seeded defects are a bounded regression check, not a statistical sensitivity, specificity, accuracy or supported-content-retention estimate.

The mutations preserve source citations and contradictory untouched graph fields. Detection can use internal consistency together with source review; this is not calibrated detection of every fluent, internally consistent unsupported claim.

Source obligations are supplied as the complete pre-existing candidate-blind obligation set. This test does not establish autonomous discovery of all important scientific requirements without that scaffold.
Visible inputs and recorded command/helper access show no host expected-answer or other-attempt exposure. Trace separation is not OS-enforced isolation or proof against every unrecorded channel.
A passage request or literal print establishes observable access, not proof of private attention, reasoning quality or exhaustive interpretation.
Most positive judgments in the full review were not independently re-audited here; this audit focuses on the seeded fields, specified omission, provenance and exclusion behavior.

The native attempt read operational AGENTS instructions before its successful location check and recovered from a namespace-start failure, a system-python Unicode failure and a missing optional Flow key. These are recorded operational issues, not expected-label exposure.
No prompts, labels, seeded defects, scientific outputs or expected judgments were changed during this audit.
The flawed graph was withheld; diagnostic exports were generated. No supported or canonical atlas publication occurred.
